faqs.answer: It offers up to six times the throughput with genuine walkaway automation, low-pressure steam heating, and the ability to replace several separate rotary evaporators with one unit.

faqs.question: How does the Rocket Synergy 2 ensure sample safety?

faqs.question: How do I set up direct-vial concentration to improve sample recovery?
faqs.answer: Use Flip-Flop and SampleGenie technology to concentrate or dry the sample directly in its storage or autosampler vial, avoiding a separate transfer step that would otherwise reduce recovery.

longForm.heroLead: A rotary evaporator processes one flask at a time. Rocket Synergy 2 was built to stop that from being the bottleneck. It runs up to six times the throughput of a rotary evaporator, with genuine walkaway automation, low-pressure steam heating, and auto-draining built in. One compact unit takes the place of several separate evaporators on the bench. Dri-Pure anti-bumping technology eliminates foaming, bumping, and cross-contamination between samples. Flip-Flop and SampleGenie let you concentrate or dry directly in storage or autosampler vials, so nothing needs transferring afterward, and recovery stays consistent sample to sample.

sections.title: Steam Heating and Sample Recovery
body: Two things usually cost you time and sample after evaporation: waiting for a slow heating method, and transferring the concentrated sample somewhere else afterward. Rocket Synergy 2 addresses both directly.

Low-pressure steam heating maximizes drying efficiency, and the chamber design is specifically built to keep moisture from reaching the sample during the process. On the recovery side, Flip-Flop and SampleGenie let concentration or drying happen directly in the storage or autosampler vial the sample is going to live in anyway, which is what actually improves recovery and keeps results consistent from one sample to the next, rather than losing material in a transfer step.
